ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Deal flow, Term sheet and later stages need Term sheet status, Amount and Pre-money valuation.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "Deal_flow", CASE(StageName, "Sourced", 1, "Screening", 2, "First meeting", 3, "Deep dive", 4, "Partner meeting", 5, "Term sheet", 6, "Due diligence", 7, "Investment committee", 8, "Invested", 9, 0) >= 6, OR(ISBLANK(TEXT(Term_sheet_status__c)), ISBLANK(Amount), ISBLANK(Pre_money_valuation__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Term sheet status, Amount and Pre-money valuation before moving to Term sheet.
